hero.headline: Track your cycle. Own your health.
hero.sub: Shustho is a free, offline-first period and reproductive health tracker built for Bangladesh. Your data stays on your device — private, secure, and yours alone.

items.title: Period tracking
items.desc: Log your period with one tap. Track cycle length, duration, and regularity.

items.title: Flow measurement
items.desc: Record flow intensity from light to heavy. Track products used and symptoms.

items.title: AI predictions
items.desc: Smart predictions for your next period. Adapts to irregular cycles and PCOS.

items.title: Nutrition hub
items.desc: Phase-based meal suggestions. Iron-rich foods, PCOS-friendly recipes, water tracking.

items.title: Pain tracker
items.desc: Log pain levels 1–10, location, and relief methods. Identify patterns over time.

items.title: Mood & mind
items.desc: Track daily mood, energy, and sleep. Understand emotional patterns with your cycle.

items.title: Health alerts
items.desc: Red flag detection for serious symptoms. Guidance on when to see a doctor.

items.title: Guardian care
items.desc: Share selected health updates with trusted family. Full privacy control.

items.title: PCOS support
items.desc: Dedicated tracking for PCOS, endometriosis, PMDD, and more conditions.

steps.title: Log your period
steps.desc: Tap to record your period start and end dates. Add flow intensity and symptoms.

steps.title: Track daily
steps.desc: Log pain, mood, nutrition, and any health changes each day.

steps.title: Get insights
steps.desc: View trends, predictions, and personalized health tips based on your data.

steps.title: Share & care
steps.desc: Optionally share updates with a guardian. Export reports for your doctor.

items.name: PCOS
items.desc: Polycystic ovary syndrome affects hormone levels and ovulation. Shustho tracks the symptom patterns that matter for diagnosis and management.

items.name: Endometriosis
items.desc: Tissue similar to the uterine lining grows outside the uterus, often causing severe pain. Detailed pain logs help doctors spot patterns faster.

items.name: PMDD
items.desc: A severe form of premenstrual syndrome affecting mood. Daily mood tracking reveals the cyclical pattern that distinguishes PMDD.

items.name: Fibroids
items.desc: Non-cancerous growths in the uterus that can affect flow and pain. Flow tracking over time highlights changes worth discussing with a doctor.

items.name: Thyroid
items.desc: Thyroid conditions can disrupt cycle regularity. Long-term cycle-length trends make irregularities easy to spot.

guardian.title: Guardian feature
guardian.desc: Choose exactly what a trusted family member sees — a period start, a severe pain alert, a mood summary. Nothing more. You can revoke access at any time.

items.quote: Shustho helped me identify my PCOS symptoms early. The doctor report feature saved me so much time.

items.quote: Finally a period tracker that works offline. I don't worry about my data being sold.
items.name: Nusrat

items.a: Yes. By default all your health data is stored locally on your device using encrypted local storage. Nothing is sent to a server unless you explicitly enable cloud backup.

items.q: Can I use Shustho without internet?
items.a: Yes. Period logging, symptom tracking, charts, insights, and report generation all work fully offline.

items.q: How accurate are the period predictions?
items.a: Predictions improve as you log more cycles and adapt automatically to irregular patterns, including PCOS-related irregularity.
Yes. Shustho has dedicated tracking for PCOS alongside endometriosis, PMDD, fibroids, and thyroid conditions.

items.q: How does the guardian feature work?
items.a: You choose a trusted person and exactly what they can see — cycle status, severe pain alerts, mood summaries, or more. You can revoke access at any time.
Yes. Every screen, alert, health tip, and report is available in both Bangla and English.

items.q: Can I export data for my doctor?
items.a: Yes. Generate a formatted PDF or CSV report for any date range from the Health tab.

items.q: Will there be ads or paid features?
items.a: No. Shustho is free forever with no ads and no paid tiers.

footer.tagline: Free, private, offline-first health tracking for Bangladesh.
